CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vibebloom_vpn_nodes (
  region_code VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY,
  region_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  aws_region VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  instance_type VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 't3.micro (Free Tier)',
  ebs_gb INTEGER DEFAULT 10,
  status VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT 'STOPPED',
  public_ip VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT 'Auto-Assigned on Boot',
  wg_port INTEGER DEFAULT 51820,
  scraper_port INTEGER DEFAULT 8085,
  hours_used_month NUMERIC(6,2) DEFAULT 0.0,
  last_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  auto_stop_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  browser_profile VARCHAR(64),
  target_timezone VARCHAR(64),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

ALTER TABLE vibebloom_vpn_nodes ALTER COLUMN status TYPE VARCHAR(128);
ALTER TABLE vibebloom_vpn_nodes ALTER COLUMN aws_region TYPE VARCHAR(128);
ALTER TABLE vibebloom_vpn_nodes ALTER COLUMN public_ip TYPE VARCHAR(128);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vibebloom_scraped_trends (
  trend_hash VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  marketplace VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  search_keyword VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  trend_title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  currency VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  avg_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
  demand_score INTEGER NOT NULL,
  competition_level VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'Low-Med',
  ai_pod_slogan VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  printify_blank VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  ai_tiktok_hook TEXT NOT NULL,
  ai_hashtags VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  store_reroute_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  ai_model_used VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'gemini-2.5-flash + ollama',
  scraped_via VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'Paced Multi-Region Scraper',
  scraped_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vibebloom_mobile_telemetry (
  account_handle VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  platform VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'TikTok + IG Reels',
  posts_published INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  views_24h INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  bio_link_clicks_24h INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  ad_spend_usd NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  revenue_usd NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  orders_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  account_health VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '100% Clean (Static US Residential IP)',

UPDATE vibebloom_scraped_trends
SET store_reroute_url = REPLACE(store_reroute_url, '/webhook/vibebloom-store', '/webhook/loulouandluxe-store')
WHERE store_reroute_url LIKE '%/webhook/vibebloom-store%';

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(v ORDER BY CASE v.region_code WHEN 'US' THEN 1 WHEN 'UK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), '[]'::json) FROM vibebloom_vpn_nodes v) AS vpn_nodes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM vibebloom_scraped_trends ORDER BY scraped_at DESC, demand_score DESC LIMIT 24) t) AS trends,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m ORDER BY m.region_code), '[]'::json) FROM vibebloom_mobile_telemetry m) AS telemetry;
